description: mise.toml's tools, and the Go version in mise.toml and every go.mod; Dependabot keeps the Go modules and GitHub Actions current.

packageRules.description: Dependabot updates the modules; Renovate reads go.mod only for its go directive.
The go directive, which CI installs through setup-go: bump it, not widen it.
One PR moves Go everywhere at once, so mise.toml and the five go.mod files never disagree.
